successCriteria.description: No line in docs/DOMAIN.md contains a heading marker preceded by other non-whitespace content on the same line: the evidence string `| offset | number | false |## balance` no longer occurs anywhere in the file, and no line matches the pattern `<non-whitespace>## `.
`## balance` occurs exactly once in docs/DOMAIN.md, as a standalone line starting at column 0, immediately preceded by a blank line (the line before it is empty).
The `LeaveRequestQueryParams` table's final row is preserved byte-for-byte in content (`| offset | number | false |`) and remains the last row of that table, terminated by its own newline.

The `balance` section's body is unchanged in content and now sits under the restored `## balance` heading: the heading is followed by a blank line, then the existing description paragraph, then the existing `### Balance` and `### LeaveBalance` subsections in their original order.

The change is confined to the single defect: the diff against the pre-fix file touches only the line(s) at the `LeaveRequestQueryParams`/`balance` boundary — no other heading, table, row, entity description, or prose in docs/DOMAIN.md is added, removed, reordered, or reworded.

The `review/documentation` finding at docs/DOMAIN.md:96 recorded in .gestalt/93f4284a-e320-4118-8414-2e6818ef21e0/feature-review-findings.md no longer reproduces: its quoted evidence line is absent from the file.

constraints: The fix is a whitespace/newline-only edit to docs/DOMAIN.md. No word, table cell, field name, type, or description text may change — the only permitted difference is the insertion of a line break (and the blank line that follows it) between the end of the `LeaveRequestQueryParams` table and the `## balance` heading.

No file under src/, web/, tests/, migrations/, seeds/, or scripts/ may be modified, and no source, test, migration, or configuration file may be added or deleted. This phase changes documentation only.

The heading level and exact heading text must be preserved as `## balance` (two hashes, lowercase `balance`, no trailing punctuation or whitespace). Do not renumber, rename, or re-level it, and do not merge it into the `leave` section.

The file must remain valid, well-formed Markdown with LF line endings and no trailing whitespace introduced on the repaired lines; the surrounding sections must keep their existing blank-line separation convention (blank line before a `##` heading, blank line after it).

Do NOT opportunistically correct the other known drift in docs/DOMAIN.md (the stale `LeaveRequest.leaveTypeId` / `approvedBy` / `approvedAt` fields, `EmploymentStatus.INACTIVE`, and the `audit` section's `oldValues`/`newValues`/`performedBy`/`performedAt` shapes). docs/ARCHITECTURE.md records that drift as deliberate and uncorrected; fixing it here would exceed the finding and invalidate the review's evidence.

The change must land on the fix branch so that a push-triggered CI run occurs: the touched path must remain under `docs/**` (the path set .github/workflows/gestalt-fix-ci.yml triggers on). Do not add a source-file change to force CI, and do not modify the workflow.

No new tooling, dependency, lint rule, or CI job may be introduced to enforce this fix (no markdown linter added to package.json, no new workflow). The repository has no markdown-lint step today and this phase does not add one.
outOfScope: Correcting the other documented drift in docs/DOMAIN.md (stale LeaveRequest fields, EmploymentStatus values, and the audit section's entity shapes) — recorded in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md as known and deliberately uncorrected.
Adding, removing, or restructuring any section, entity, table, or field in docs/DOMAIN.md beyond restoring the `## balance` heading to its own line.
Any change to the leave cancellation / approver-notification / pending-decisions feature (src/modules/leave, src/modules/notification, migrations, tests) — this phase is a documentation repair only.

The other open finding in the same feature review (`review/stale-spec` at docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:1719, the recipient-resolution placement wording) — a separate finding with its own file and its own fix.
Introducing a markdown-formatting check, generator, or CI gate that would prevent this class of defect recurring — not requested by the finding and not part of this phase.

ambiguities.description: Whether the repaired heading must be preceded by a blank line (i.e. the table row line, then an empty line, then `## balance`) or merely start its own line directly after the table row. The intent states "preceded by a blank line"; the finding's own wording only says "Restore the newline so `## balance` starts its own line".
options: Insert a blank line between the table row and `## balance` (matches the intent and the file's convention for every other `##` heading)
Only break the line so `## balance` starts its own line, with no blank line inserted

ambiguities.description: Whether the phase should also edit the finding record in .gestalt/93f4284a-e320-4118-8414-2e6818ef21e0/feature-review-findings.md to mark the `review/documentation` finding resolved.
options: Leave the findings file untouched — the platform marks a finding fixed when it stops being reported and its file changed
Update the findings file's status column as part of this phase

entityInvariants.invariant: Every top-level module section is a `## <module-name>` heading that begins its own line at column 0, is preceded by a blank line, and is followed by a blank line then its description paragraph. The `balance` section must satisfy this exactly as `leave`, `employee`, `policy`, `notification`, `audit`, and `validation` already do.

The section is a sibling of `leave`, not a child of it: it is terminated only by the next `##` heading (`## employee`) and owns exactly the content it owned before the defect — the description paragraph plus the `### Balance` and `### LeaveBalance` subsections. No content moves between the `leave` and `balance` sections.

The table remains a complete, well-formed Markdown table: header row, separator row, and all eight data rows including the final `| offset | number | false |` row, each on its own line. The table's last row is not truncated, merged, or absorbed into the following heading.

The `leave` section's content is unchanged: it still ends at the `LeaveRequestQueryParams` table and does not gain the `balance` description, `### Balance`, or `### LeaveBalance` as its own subsections.

interfaceConstraints.operation: Read docs/DOMAIN.md as a Markdown document and resolve its heading structure
interfaceConstraints.authRule: None — the file is a repository document with no access control.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: After the fix, parsing the document yields `balance` as a distinct top-level section; before the fix it does not. No parse error is expected in either state — the defect is silent (the heading renders as literal text inside a table row), which is why the check must be structural rather than a parse-failure check.

interfaceConstraints.operation: Apply the fix repeatedly (re-run / re-apply on an already-fixed file)
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Applying the fix to an already-correct file must be a no-op: it must not insert a second blank line, duplicate the heading, or otherwise alter the file. The result of applying it twice equals the result of applying it once.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Match the exact heading form and blank-line separation used by the file's other top-level module sections — `## leave`, `## employee`, `## policy`, `## notification`, `## audit`, `## validation` — rather than inventing a new heading style or level.

The repaired line must be the inverse of the recorded defect: the finding's quoted evidence `| offset | number | false |## balance` must no longer match, and the finding's own prescribed fix ("Restore the newline so `## balance` starts its own line") must be satisfied verbatim.

The fix must be the same one-line repair the workflow file documents as the canonical fix for this defect ("`## balance` moved back onto its own line"), so the workflow's stated rationale stays true and the docs-only fix path it exists to enable actually fires.

Do not contradict the maintained architecture's recorded position on docs/DOMAIN.md: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md states the file is stale relative to it and that the drift is known and not corrected. This phase repairs formatting only and must leave every recorded entity-shape drift in place.
